inventory.test: locks reviews, business, and response before attempt ownership and durable writes
a downgrade's refusal_events row carries the account_id read by the transaction's existing business lock
the in-transaction downgrade writes the refusal on the caller transaction and an outer rollback removes it
inventory.reason: Its hunk inside round 2's range (7c9bd9cd..c9f2f6bb) is comment-only: no assertion and no production behaviour changed, so a mutation would measure round 1's surface rather than this round's fix. Round 1 mutated and killed this case. The comment's factual accuracy, which is what the fix actually changed, is verified statically under Duty 3: refusal_events.business_id REFERENCES businesses(id) (116_refusal_events.sql:77), the caller holds that row FOR UPDATE (auto-policy-downgrade.ts:114-119), and FOR UPDATE conflicts with the FK's FOR KEY SHARE, so the independent-connection insert blocks.

findings.title: The fix for the FROM businesses comment-resolution defect reintroduces it: the new prohibition comment contains the literal it prohibits, businessLock still resolves to a comment (:108, not the query at :116), and an arbiter-confirmed mutation that stops the business rung locking businesses SURVIVES the lock-order test; deleting the six comment lines kills the same mutant
findings.arbiter_reasoning: NOT EQUIVALENT: the mutation changes the table the business rung locks (FROM businesses -> FROM accounts at :116, FOR UPDATE retained), so at HEAD the function body contains no 'FROM businesses' outside the prohibition comment and the documented reviews->businesses->responses ladder loses its middle rung. That is exactly the property the test's own title asserts ('locks reviews, business, and response before attempt ownership and durable writes'). NOT AN UNEXECUTED BRANCH: the test's oracle is the source TEXT of the file (readFileSync at auto-policy-downgrade-lock-order.test.ts:6), so it reads the mutated region unconditionally on every run; there is no conditional path that could skip it. CAUSATION PROVEN BY CONTROL: the identical mutant with the six prohibition-comment lines (:108-113) deleted is KILLED with 'AssertionError: expected -1 to be greater than 1143', so the surviving assertion is masked by the comment and by nothing else. Resolution measured directly by executing the test's own indexOf chain: businessLock lands at offset 2477 (:108, the comment) rather than 2998 (:116, the query); at the fork point 06a163f0 it landed correctly on the query. SEVERITY BOUND, recorded for honesty: the same mutant IS killed by auto-policy-downgrade.test.ts:171, whose ordered-ladder equality is a runtime-SQL oracle unaffected by comments, so no production correctness defect escapes the branch's overall surface. The P0 is that the lock-order test's business rung is a proven-fake assertion and that the fix's own prohibition comment states a rule it violates.
findings.reason: The prohibition no longer spells the phrase it forbids: it now reads "NO COMMENT ABOVE THIS STATEMENT MAY SPELL THIS QUERY'S `FROM` CLAUSE", with the double-catch recorded so the indirection is not "clarified" back into a quotation. Verified by MEASUREMENT rather than inspection, running the test's own indexOf chain over the file at HEAD: all six rungs now resolve to statements — anchor :86, businessLock :122 ('FROM businesses'), responseLock :133, attemptClaim :142, responseMutation :152, auditWrite :170 — with none landing on a comment line.

findings.title: The restated per-round plan-review counts are not resolvable at HEAD: only round 1's 'Eight findings' has an in-repo artifact (plan:237); round 2's 4 findings and round 3's 0/APPROVED have none, and the new sum of 12 silently replaces this branch's own earlier durable 'fourteen'
findings.reason: The finding was right that the counts named no artifact: rounds 2 and 3 happened but were recorded only in the intake and in conversation, never in the plan. Fixed at the source rather than by softening the claim — the plan's review appendix now carries a Round 2 section (VERDICT REVISE, four findings, all amendment drift, with the specific HIGH and MEDIUM named) and a Round 3 section (VERDICT APPROVED, the cap). All three per-round counts in the log row now resolve to plan artifacts.

findings.title: A third variant of the corrected test arithmetic survives in gitignored session state that /feature-resume reads back: tracer T1's note still says '19 titles, 13 RED; 6 are negative-space/preservation assertions', matching neither the old claim (13/7) nor the corrected one (12/7)
findings.reason: Tracer T1's note now reads "19 titles, 12 RED; 7 are negative-space regression pins (red team planted each forbidden defect; all seven died)", matching the corrected 12/7/19. The finding's real point is kept: gitignored session state is still state a resumed run reads back, so a count corrected in tracked artifacts alone leaves a third variant alive where the next session will find it first.
